PDF templates and workflows (English)
Merge and compress PDF
Combine PDFs in your chosen order, then reduce the merged file size in one browser workflow. Review the result and download one PDF for free.
Merge PDF and add page numbers
Combine PDF files and add continuous page numbers across the merged document. Choose the file order and starting number, then download one PDF.
Merge PDF and add a watermark
Merge PDFs and apply one text watermark across the combined document. Enter a label such as DRAFT, arrange the files and download the result.
Combine Word documents into one PDF
Convert multiple DOCX documents and combine their pages into one PDF. Arrange the documents in order and download a single combined PDF file.
How to use Merge PDF

Combine PDF pages in a selected file order.

Input: application/pdf. Output: application/pdf.

Select at least two PDFs.
Arrange the files in the order they should appear.
Merge and download, then check page order.
Processing, privacy and limitations
How are my files processed?
Files are processed in your browser; this tool does not upload the selected file for processing.
What limitations should I check?
Review form fields, bookmarks and document-level settings after combining files.
